title: Permanent resident international travel - basics
facts: Brief travel outside the United States generally does not affect permanent resident status, but extended or fact-specific travel can raise abandonment issues.
An absence of more than 1 year is an important travel-document threshold for permanent residents and a reentry permit may be relevant before departure.
Border officers may consider factors beyond trip length when assessing whether permanent residence was abandoned, including ties to the United States and intent.
Travel rules for maintaining permanent residence are distinct from naturalization continuous-residence rules.
